findings.summary: The clone ended in a verified whiteout; live execution remains forbidden.
findings.observed_fact: All six party members fainted while Sunflora remained at 34/54 HP.

findings.summary: At the earliest causal divergence, the policy switched Birdlaw into Ponyta instead of using the verified one-turn Bulldoze finish with Lildozer.

resolution.observed: Bounded replay from turn 005 used Lildozer Bulldoze; Ponyta fainted immediately, no enemy reply occurred, and the step had no discrepancy.

findings.observed_fact: The selected switch was followed by a critical Play Rough and began the subsequent attrition loop.

findings.summary: The failed branch reached Sunflora with every viable answer already in critical condition; this was downstream of the Ponyta switch loop, not a reason to keep retrying the same party line.
findings.observed_fact: At Sunflora entry Ohmnomnom was 10/52, Birdlaw 18/46, Croakatoa 17/44, Bushtank 22/57, and Lildozer 5/58; direct Birdlaw and Croakatoa switches were each verified KOs.

findings.summary: The declarative strategy had no Birdlaw Aerial Ace preference for Sunflora, despite the recorded endgame role and verified damage evidence.
findings.improvement: Added the reusable Birdlaw/Aerial Ace-versus-Sunflora rule to the strategy record.

findings.summary: The forced-switch scorer selected poisoned, seeded, and sleeping Coppertop as the least-bad reserve, then spent two turns on prevented Tackle actions while the endgame was already lost.
findings.observed_fact: Coppertop entered at 24/56 with status, both Tackle actions were prevented, and the status-bearing finisher fainted before dealing damage.

findings.summary: Nineteen switches in 31 actions traded away HP without removing Ponyta or creating a safe Sunflora entry.
The line spent 12 move actions, 19 switches, and six allied faints; the losses were primarily HP and reserve access rather than PP.
The 31-action line was longer than the verified 22-action historical win; speed work is secondary until the survival line is restored.

correct_choices: Spark removed Bibarel while preserving the lead through Super Fang.
The corrected fixed-damage handling did not repeat the prior Super Fang critical-bound error.
All 31 action results matched authoritative RAM without an execution or observation discrepancy.
agent_review.next_test: Start the next disposable clone only after this review is persisted; verify the turn-005 Bulldoze exception, then check that Sunflora is met with a healthy preserved answer before qualification continues.
